role: Division Administrator / Division Engineer, FHWA Illinois Division
stance_basis: listed as FHWA Division Engineer contact person for the proposal and Final EIS; letters signed on his behalf support the project process
summary: Jay W. Miller is identified as the FHWA Illinois Division Engineer and one of two primary contact persons for the proposed Lincoln Highway improvement and its Final Environmental Impact Statement. He is named as the signatory authority for two December 30, 1975 letters (signed by his assistant Manuel A. Marks on his behalf) notifying the Council on Environmental Quality and the Illinois DOT of the substitution of a Negative Declaration for the draft EIS. His role is administrative and procedural rather than one of advocacy or opposition.
complaint_summary: A letter signed by Manuel A. Marks for Jay W. Miller notifies the Illinois DOT Director that a Negative Declaration has been substituted for the draft EIS and instructs the state to notify all agencies and individuals who commented, while noting that a Section 4(f) Statement will still be required for Cook County Forest Preserve lands.

statement.text:
Dear Mr. Kramer:
Subject: Draft Environmental Impact Statement
Illinois Project F-239( )
FAP-23, US-30 (Lincoln Highway) Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road
Cook County
FHWA-ILL-EIS-72-16-D
Enclosed for your information is a copy of our letter of December 30, 1975 to the Council on Environmental Quality advising that we have substituted a Negative Declaration for the subject draft EIS.
As soon as possible you should notify all agencies and individuals who commented on the draft EIS, or who requested a copy of the final EIS, that the substitution has been made. A copy of our letter to the Council on Environmental Quality may be used as an enclosure with your letter if you so desire.
Please note that the substitution does not affect the need for approval of use of Section 4(f) lands. A Section 4(f) Statement will be needed so that we can request approval of use of lands owned by the Cook County Forest Preserve District.
Sincerely yours,
Marrark
Manuel A. Marks
Assistant Division Administrator
For: Jay W. Miller Division Administrator
Enclosure
